image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a bed of green moss and brown earth. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow spots running along its back and sides. Its skin appears wet and reflective. The head is visible on the right, showing a broad shape, while the tail extends to the left, curving slightly. The limbs are short and tucked against the body.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible, exhibiting the characteristic broad, flattened shape. While the specific glandular texture is hard to resolve at this resolution, the overall morphology matches the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is visible, appears laterally compressed, and is clearly shorter than the visible portion of the body. The tip curves out of frame but the base structure is correct.
